newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Total Access in $200 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Total Access in $200 mln credit facility.

text.p: Total Access Communication Public Co Ltd's US$200 million revolving credit facility has been completed, arranger Union Bank of Switzerland said on Friday.
The facility was oversubscribed to more than US$282 million but not increased, the arranger said.
The facility carries a maturity of one year. It is structured as a standby letter of credit facility with banks offered a standby letter of credit fee of 37.5 basis points.
There is a front-end fee for top-tier managers of 12.5 basis points, giving an all-in return of 50 basis points. Arranger Union Bank of Switzerland committed to US$12 million.

Co-arrangers are Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co's Singapore branch, with US$11 million, and Banca Commerciale Italiana's Singapore branch, Bank of Nova Scotia, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi's Bangkok branch, CIBC CEF, Dresdner Bank's Bangkok branch, National Australia Bank's Singapore branch, Royal Bank of Canada's Singapore branch and Standard Chartered Bank's Bangkok branch, with US$10.5 million each.

Lead managers, with US$6.5 million each, are Banque Indosuez's Bangkok branch, Banque Paribas's Singapore branch, GiroCredit Bank, Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp, International Commercial Bank of China's Singapore branch, ING Bank's Thailand, Development Bank of Singapore and Tokai Bank's Hongkong branch.

Managers are Industrial Bank of Japan's Bangkok branch, with US$5 million, and Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de I'Etate Luxembourg, Die Erste Osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank, Fuji Bank's Singapore branch, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino SpA's Singapore branch, Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein International, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp's Hongkong branch, Nord/LB's Singapore branch, Tat Lee Bank and Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA's Singapore branch, with US$4 million each.
Signing is tentatively set for May 26 in Singapore.
